input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 provides one-year automatic renewals (acceptable renewal term length) but conditions non-renewal on ninety (90) days' written notice. That is a 90-day non-renewal window, which fails the fallback ceiling of 60 days and sits at the edge of walk-away territory, so it is a material deviation. We therefore target the fallback and shorten the window to 60 days. The renewal is on the existing terms and the Section 3.1 revenue-share (30% of Net Sales above the monthly threshold) contains no renewal price-increase mechanic anywhere in the document, so the conditional price-cap element is not triggered; the absence of an express CPI/3% cap and of a vendor renewal reminder are preferred-level refinements noted here only and not separately flagged.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The one-year automatic renewal currently requires ninety (90) days' notice to avoid renewal, which exceeds our position; we have shortened the non-renewal notice window to sixty (60) days (our fallback). Renewal remains on the existing revenue-share economics with no price uplift, which is acceptable.
proposal.summary: Shorten the non-renewal notice window in Section 4.1 from 90 days to 60 days.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
